name: @sabbour/squadboard-monorepo
description: Pre-alpha local-first kanban + workflow board for Squad agents

scripts.npm:build: pnpm --filter @sabbour/squadboard-sdk run build && pnpm --filter @sabbour/squadboard-cli run build && pnpm --filter @sabbour/squadboard run build
scripts.npm:publish:dry-run: pnpm --filter @sabbour/squadboard-sdk publish --dry-run --no-git-checks --access public && pnpm --filter @sabbour/squadboard-cli publish --dry-run --no-git-checks --access public && pnpm --filter @sabbour/squadboard publish --dry-run --no-git-checks --access public
scripts.dev:electron: pnpm --filter @sabbour/squadboard run dev & SERVER_PID=$!; pnpm --filter @sabbour/squadboard-electron run dev; kill $SERVER_PID 2>/dev/null; wait $SERVER_PID 2>/dev/null; true
scripts.npm:publish: pnpm --filter @sabbour/squadboard-sdk publish --no-git-checks --access public && pnpm --filter @sabbour/squadboard-cli publish --no-git-checks --access public && pnpm --filter @sabbour/squadboard publish --no-git-checks --access public
